Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Bhavana Bhandari. I am a 48-year-old fashion designer living in Vadodara. Karve Textiles Pvt Ltd gave me a cheque for ₹12,50,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. My case number is CC/2441/2022 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Vadodara. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 79226 68456 or email bhavana.bhandari@example.com.
